plugins.name: cairoaffineblend
plugins.author: Janne Liljeblad
plugins.explanation: Composites second input on first input applying user-defined transformation, opacity and blend mode

params.name: x
params.explanation: X position of second input, value interperted as range -2*width - 3*width

params.name: y
params.explanation: Y position of second input, value interperted as range -2*height - 3*height

params.name: x scale
params.explanation: X scale of second input, value interperted as range 0 - 5

params.name: y scale
params.explanation: Y scale of second input, value interperted as range 0 - 5

params.name: rotation
params.explanation: Rotation of second input, value interperted as range 0 - 360

params.name: blend mode
params.explanation: Blend mode used to compose image. Accepted values: 'normal', 'add', 'saturate', 'multiply', 'screen', 'overlay', 'darken', 'lighten', 'colordodge', 'colorburn', 'hardlight', 'softlight', 'difference', 'exclusion', 'hslhue', 'hslsaturation', 'hslcolor', 'hslluminosity'

params.name: anchor x
params.explanation: X position of rotation center within the second input

params.name: anchor y
params.explanation: Y position of rotation center within the second input

plugins.name: cairoblend
plugins.author: Janne Liljeblad
plugins.explanation: Composites second input on the first input with user-defined blend mode and opacity.

params.name: blend mode
params.explanation: Blend mode used to compose image. Accepted values: 'normal', 'add', 'saturate', 'multiply', 'screen', 'overlay', 'darken', 'lighten', 'colordodge', 'colorburn', 'hardlight', 'softlight', 'difference', 'exclusion', 'hslhue', 'hslsaturation', 'hslcolor', 'hslluminosity'

plugins.name: cairogradient
plugins.author: Janne Liljeblad
plugins.explanation: Draws a gradient on top of image. Filter is given gradient start and end points, colors and opacities.

params.name: start opacity
params.explanation: Opacity of the first color of the gradient

params.name: end opacity
params.explanation: Opacity of the second color of the gradient

params.name: start x
params.explanation: X position of the start point of the gradient

params.name: start y
params.explanation: Y position of the start point of the gradient

params.name: end x
params.explanation: X position of the end point of the gradient

params.name: end y
params.explanation: Y position of the end point of the gradient

params.name: offset
params.explanation: Position of first color in the line connecting gradient ends, really useful only for radial gradient

params.name: blend mode
params.explanation: Blend mode used to compose gradient on image. Accepted values: 'normal', 'add', 'saturate', 'multiply', 'screen', 'overlay', 'darken', 'lighten', 'colordodge', 'colorburn', 'hardlight', 'softlight', 'difference', 'exclusion', 'hslhue', 'hslsaturation', 'hslcolor', 'hslluminosity'

plugins.name: cairoimagegrid
plugins.author: Janne Liljeblad
plugins.explanation: Draws a grid of input images.

params.name: rows
params.explanation: Number of rows in the image grid. Input range 0 - 1 is interpreted as range 1 - 20

params.name: columns
params.explanation: Number of columns in the image grid. Input range 0 - 1 is interpreted as range 1 - 20

params.name: triplevel
params.explanation: level of trip: mapped to [0,1] asymptotical

params.name: diffspace
params.explanation: difference space: a value from 0 to 256 (mapped to [0,1])

plugins.name: K-Means Clustering
plugins.author: binarymillenium

plugins.name: White Balance (LMS space)
plugins.author: Steinar H. Gunderson
plugins.explanation: Do simple color correction, in a physically meaningful way

params.name: Neutral Color
params.explanation: Choose a color from the source image that should be white.

params.name: Color Temperature
params.explanation: Choose an output color temperature, if different from 6500 K.

plugins.name: color_only
plugins.author: Jean-Sebastien Senecal
plugins.explanation: Perform a conversion to color only of the source input1 using the hue and saturation values of input2.

plugins.name: coloradj_RGB
plugins.author: Marko Cebokli
plugins.explanation: Simple color adjustment

params.name: Alpha controlled
params.explanation: Adjust only areas with nonzero alpha

plugins.name: Color Distance
plugins.author: Richard Spindler
plugins.explanation: Calculates the distance between the selected color and the current pixel and uses that value as new pixel value

plugins.name: colorhalftone
plugins.author: Janne Liljeblad
plugins.explanation: Filters image to resemble a halftone print in which tones are represented as variable sized dots

params.name: hue
params.explanation: Color shade of the colorized image

params.name: saturation
params.explanation: Amount of color in the colorized image

plugins.author: Janne Liljeblad
plugins.explanation: Applies a pre-made color effect to image

params.name: table
params.explanation: Lookup table used to filter colors. One of: xpro, sepia, heat, red_green, old_photo, xray, esses, yellow_blue

plugins.name: Composition
plugins.author: Richard Spindler

plugins.name: Contrast0r
plugins.author: Jean-Sebastien Senecal

plugins.name: Curves
plugins.author: Maksim Golovkin, Till Theato
plugins.explanation: Adjust luminance or color channel intensity with curve level mapping

params.name: Channel
params.explanation: Channel to adjust (0 = red, 0.1 = green, 0.2 = blue, 0.3 = alpha, 0.4 = luma, 0.5 = rgb, 0.6 = hue, 0.7 = saturation)

params.name: Show curves
params.explanation: Draw curve graph on output image

params.name: Graph position
params.explanation: Output image corner where curve graph will be drawn (0.1 = TOP,LEFT; 0.2 = TOP,RIGHT; 0.3 = BOTTOM,LEFT; 0.4 = BOTTOM, RIGHT)

params.name: Curve point number
params.explanation: Number of points to use to build curve (/10 to fit [0,1] parameter range). Minimum 2 (0.2), Maximum 5 (0.5). Not relevant for Bézier spline.

params.name: Bézier spline
params.explanation: Use cubic Bézier spline. Has to be a sorted list of points in the format "handle1x;handle1y#pointx;pointy#handle2x;handle2y"(pointx = in, pointy = out). Points are separated by a "|".The values can have "double" precision. x, y for points should be in the range 0-1. x,y for handles might also be out of this range.

params.name: Legend
